results.title: SpaceX Starship Flight 14 reaches orbital velocity, sticks first-stage catch
results.snippet: SpaceX's Starship vehicle completed its 14th integrated flight test on Saturday, achieving orbital velocity for the first time and successfully catching the Super Heavy booster with the launch tower's chopstick arms.

results.title: Live updates: SpaceX Starship Flight 14
results.snippet: Liftoff occurred at 7:21 AM CT from Starbase, Texas. Both stages performed nominally through MECO; booster catch confirmed by Elon Musk on X. Upper stage continued to planned splashdown in the Indian Ocean.

results.title: Analysis: what Flight 14 means for Artemis and Mars cadence
results.snippet: Successful booster reuse via tower catch shaves an estimated 12-18 months off Starship's reusability timeline. NASA's Artemis III HLS milestone now depends on tanker-flight cadence.
